name: Port Perry–Whitby / Beaverton
description: Rural GO bus between Whitby GO, Port Perry and communities north to Beaverton. Timetables also show the short Port Perry–Whitby branch. Union times were connecting train times, not an 81 through bus.

timeline.event: The timetable documents Beaverton–Cannington–Sunderland–Port Perry–Whitby 81 and Port Perry–Whitby 81A.
GO added Beaverton weekday trips and provided three weekend trips in each direction.
The route continued in the original Port Perry timetable.

gaps: The original launch date and every later local stop or road variation have not been recovered.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
